macros.name: ActiveLaLivre
macros.doc: The macro \ActiveLaLivre makes the pound active, it is used by \Pron, \PRON, and the following environment.

macros.name: EPtextestyle
macros.doc: The macro \EPtextestyle defines the style of the text of the pronunciation.

macros.name: MakeHyphenable
macros.doc: \MakeHyphenable redefines the macros linked to £H, £h, £B, £b, and £k in order that they produce cuttable marks.

macros.name: pron
macros.doc: The macro \pron{⟨text⟩} produces a presentation of the pronunciation as you can find it usually after a word in a text.
